I'll pull up what you've been doing with squats to understand where you're at. You haven't logged a squat yet, so we're starting from zero. That's fine — fear of a lift usually comes down to either not knowing what you're doing, not trusting the weight won't crush you, or both. A program that builds technical competence and confidence works for all three.

I'll build you a squat-focused program that starts light, progresses manageable, and teaches you what a heavy squat actually feels like on your body. What matters is picking a structure you'll show up for — are you looking for a full program (a couple of training days a week) or just adding squat work to what you're already doing?
